'''Susaut Volupicite''' was a horned [[alien]] with [[Color|gray]] [[hair]], brown skin and brown [[eye]]s. In [[10 BBY]], Volupicite spent [[time]] on the [[planet]] [[Vandor]] in the [[Cantina|drinking establishment]] known as [[the Lodge]]. While there, the alien took part in a game of [[sabacc]] in the building's back room but angrily left the table after being beaten by the [[smuggler]] [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian]]. Volupicite then returned to watch the outlaw [[Han Solo]] play against Calrissian.

==Biography==
[[File:Volupicite_loses.png|thumb|left|250px|Susaut Volupicite lost at sabacc to Lando Calrissian on the planet Vandor.]]
Susaut Volupicite was an [[alien]] who spent [[time]] in the [[Cantina|saloon]] known as [[the Lodge]] on the [[planet]] [[Vandor]]<ref name="SoloOG">''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story The Official Guide]]''</ref> in the [[Standard year|year]] [[10 BBY]].<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the portion of ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]'' set on [[Vandor]] to [[10 BBY]].</ref> While in the Lodge, Volupicite joined a game of the<ref name="Solo" /> [[Corellian Spike]]<ref name="SoloOG" /> variant of [[sabacc]] being played at one of the tables in the establishment's back rooms. Sitting between<ref name="Solo" /> the [[Nephran]] [[Thermoculus Krisintvolt Scissorpunch|Therm Scissorpunch]]<ref name="Species">''[[Star Wars: Alien Archive]]''</ref> and the dealer, [[Saucer Head]].<ref name="Topps">{{Topps|set=2018 Topps Solo: A Star Wars Story|cardname=Saucer Head - 18|link=https://www.tcdb.com/ViewCard.cfm/sid/162389/cid/11326507/2018-Topps-Solo:-A-Star-Wars-Story-18-Saucer-Head}}</ref> Volupicite eventually lost to the [[human]] [[smuggler]] [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian]] and left the table.<ref name="Solo" />

Following the loss, Volupicite returned to watch further rounds being played and stood behind the human criminal [[Han Solo]]. Solo and Calrissian then both [[Gambling|wagered]] their [[starship]]s on a round, and after Solo revealed his hand of cards to be [[straight staves]], Volupicite cheered with the rest of the room and clapped the criminal on the shoulder. The alien was then displeased when Calrissian revealed that he had [[Full Sabacc]], meaning he had won the game.<ref name="Solo" />

==Personality and traits==
Susaut Volupicite was annoyed at losing at sabacc to Lando Calrissian, vocalizing in<ref name="Solo" /> [[Olys Corellisi]]<ref name="YouTube">{{SWKidsYouTube|series=Star Wars By the Numbers|text=Every Language in Star Wars Movies|video=CZp8Civk2co|nolive=1}}</ref> and smashing a [[Limb|fist]] onto the game table before storming off. The alien was later pleased when it appeared that Han Solo had beaten Calrissian.<ref name="Solo" /> Volupicite was a member of a bipedal [[Susaut Volupicite's species|species]] and had [[Color|gray]] [[Hair|fur]] with brown horns, skin, and [[eye]]s.<ref name="SoloOG" />

==Equipment==
Volupicite wore a gray-and-yellow [[Clothing|outfit]] and carried a [[Glie-44 blaster pistol]] during his time on Vandor.<ref name="SoloOG" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Maverick_006.png|thumb|right|150px|Concept art of Volupicite, titled "Maverick 006"]]
Susaut Volupicite was created for the [[2018]] [[Star Wars Anthology Series|Anthology]] film, ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]'',<ref name="Solo" /> but was first revealed in a tie-in advertisement for the restaurant [[Wikipedia:Denny's|Denny's]] earlier that year. In the advertisement, Volupicite is conversing with a human woman, before both stop to watch a sabacc game being played.<ref name="Denny's">{{OfficialYouTube|channel=@dennys|name=Denny's|video=s8q-y2NkIK0|text=Solo: A Star Wars Story exclusive trading cards, available only at Denny's!|date=2018-04-02|nolive=1}}</ref>

The character was portrayed by [[Robert Nairne]]<ref name="Twitter">{{Twitter|RobertNairne|status/1029512465539837957|[[Robert Nairne]]|quote=It me! #actor #creatureperformer #StarWars #Solo|archivefile=File:Robert_Nairne_Susaut.png}} — [[Robert Nairne]] identified himself as the actor who portrayed Susaut Volupicite in response to an [https://twitter.com/dafttom/status/1029458589482663937 image] of the character also posted on Twitter {{C|[https://archive.is/PqKM4 backup link]}}.</ref> and was first named in ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story The Official Guide]]'', a reference book written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and released alongside the film.<ref name="SoloOG" /> Concept art of Volupicite, titled "Maverick 006," was drawn for the film by costume concept artist [[Adam Brockbank]] and creature concept designer and senior sculptor [[Luke Fisher]].<ref name="Art">''[[The Art of Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''</ref>
